newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Dec 21.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Dec 21.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
The government today holds peace talks with tribal Shanti Bahini rebels who have been fighting a bush war for autonomy of 5,500 sq miles of hill tracts.
Commerce and Industries Minister Tofael Ahmed, now visiting India's West Bengal state, has suggested India should lift existing restrictions on import of Bangladeshi items.
Water Resources Minister Abdur Razaak said Nepal and Bhutan would have to be included in the discussion on the question of augmentation of Ganges flow at the Farakka dam point.
The government will erect a monument to country's independence leader Sheikh Mujibur Rahman in capital Dhaka.
Four human rights groups have urged the government to end the jail revolt problem through a dialogue under the personal responsibility of the Home (interior) Minister.
British High Commissioner in Dhaka David C Walker has said the political commitment, stability and national consensus could attract more foreign investment in Bangladesh.
Private sector textile mills operators said the country would be made self sufficient in yarn by the year 2005.
